target.label: Aquarium and LocalCastBridge spatial evidence contract

memory.summary: The Perfect Machine research is worth keeping as one witness-law architecture rather than five separate article scraps.
memory.claim: Geometry, procedural detail, sensor feeds, reservoirs, occupancy memory, and rendering may share one machine only when each witness names its domain, bounds, confidence, validation story, and owning authority before reuse or fusion.
memory.tension: The article and paper stack make the machine sound grand enough to fake completion; reservoir math, splat vocabulary, TSDF fusion, and residency logic become lies if they are borrowed as atmosphere instead of bounded contracts.
memory.actionImplication: Future Mimir proposals about Aquarium or LocalCastBridge should spell out witness type, proposal source, validation rule, confidence bound, resource cost, and handoff owner before claiming a coherent field or adding hotter machinery.
